why: issue 1913 -- the REP-2011 hash each of an action's five endpoints is keyed on, a trailing member of `rclc_action_type_t` filled by the generated `ROSIDL_GET_ACTION_TYPE_SUPPORT` descriptor. rcl has no counterpart because its action type support reaches each endpoint's own type support (and hence its hash) through `rosidl_action_type_support_t`; ours is one flat descriptor, so the five hashes ride on it. NULL members fall back to `type_hash`.
